fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2, at 51a44876d (GOTMPDIR outside the repo). The two confirmed review findings are fixed. (1) go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/workflow-env$' passes; the script now expects FOO=<...>/.cache/rhiza/run-tmp/<run id>. (2) newSessionFixture sets XDG_CACHE_HOME to t.TempDir(). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestSessionRunWorkflowEnv$|Abandon|GoTmp' -v passes on two back-to-back runs (TestSessionRunWorkflowEnv, TestAbandonRemovesRunGoTmp, TestUniqueSlugShipTargetAndAbandon), and the host's ~/.cache/rhiza/run-tmp stays empty afterwards. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/run/... passes. A verbose run of the whole internal/api package passed all 628 tests. The package was still marked FAIL because the root-state guard saw ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json change during the 14-minute run on the shared host. That is the live root daemon's file and is not touched by this diff, which only changes a test fixture env and one txtar.
